name: seqscribe
description: Subscribe to sequences — writer-owned append-only log sync for SQLite. Implementation of SPEC v3.3; not yet released.

scripts.check: npm run gen:types && tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck types.d.ts && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && npm run build && tsc -p fixture
scripts.e2e:browser: npm run build && npx esbuild e2e-browser/main.src.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=e2e-browser/main.js '--external:/@sqlite.org/*' && node e2e-browser/server.mjs 8971
scripts.e2e:dashboard: npm run build && npx esbuild e2e-browser/dashboard-worker.src.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=e2e-browser/dashboard-worker.js '--external:/@sqlite.org/*' && npx esbuild e2e-browser/dashboard-main.src.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=e2e-browser/dashboard-main.js && node e2e-browser/dashboard-server.mjs 8972
